description: A group of inflammatory skin conditions characterised by itching, dryness, and inflammation.
causes: Inflammatory skin-barrier dysfunction; triggers vary by eczema subtype
risk_factors: Personal or family history of atopic disease

appearance.general: Dry, inflamed, itchy patches or plaques with variable scale, excoriation, or thickening.

warning_signs: Pain, pus, fever, rapidly spreading inflammation, or extensive blistering can indicate a complication requiring assessment.
general_first_aid: Avoid known skin irritants and excessive scratching.
prevention: Maintain skin barrier care and reduce known irritant exposures.
